notes.title: Wishlist Cybernetic Seduction - Season 1 on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42077101/89dcb41680c4a6f8de433c3bfcd5a3306d49e796.png[/img]

Hi!

After over 2 years of relentless dedication, countless upgrades in render quality, and new animation techniques, I'm super excited to show you what I've been working on: 
[b]Cybernetic Seduction Season 1[/b]! 

I poured my heart and soul into this game, and I genuinely hope you'll feel the passion shining through the screen. The journey has been amazing, and now, I'd love for you to join in on the fun!

Official release is set for May 2024. But guess what? You can wishlist it NOW on Steam! Check out the link below:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2724540/Cybernetic_Seduction__Season_1/]Cybernetic Seduction - Season 1[/url]

Dive into my Steam page, watch the new trailer, and check out the stunning renders from the game. If it catches your eye (fingers crossed!), feel free to dive deeper into the game's world!

Your support means the world to me. I couldn't have gotten here without you. Seriously, big thank you from the heart! 

Take care!
